questions.q: How many holes are on a standard golf course?
questions.e: Usually a mix of par three, four and five holes.

questions.q: What is a birdie?
questions.e: Two under is an eagle, three under an albatross.

questions.q: What is a bogey?
questions.e: A double bogey is two over.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of clubs allowed in a player's bag?
questions.e: Carrying more brings a penalty.

questions.q: What is match play?
o: Scoring by holes won rather than total strokes
questions.e: Stroke play counts every shot instead.

questions.q: What is the penalty for hitting a ball out of bounds?
o: One stroke and replay from the original spot
questions.e: Known as stroke and distance.

questions.q: What is an albatross?
o: Two under par on a hole
Three under par on a hole
questions.e: Most often a two on a par five.

questions.q: Where must a player not ground their club before a shot?
questions.e: Touching the sand before the stroke incurs a penalty.

questions.q: Which major is always played at the same course?
questions.e: Augusta National hosts it every April.

questions.q: What is awarded to the winner of the Masters?
questions.e: The champion returns it to Augusta after a year.

questions.q: Which trophy goes to the Open Championship winner?
questions.e: The Open is the oldest of the four majors.

questions.q: How many majors are there in men's professional golf?
questions.e: Masters, PGA, US Open and The Open.

questions.q: Which major is the oldest, first played in 1860?
questions.e: It began at Prestwick in Scotland.

questions.q: What is the Ryder Cup?
o: A team contest between Europe and the United States
questions.e: It is played every two years.

questions.q: Which country is the traditional home of golf?
questions.e: St Andrews is known as the home of golf.

questions.q: What is a links course?
o: A coastal course on sandy ground
questions.e: Firm turf, dunes and wind define the style.

questions.q: Who has won the most men's major championships?
questions.e: Nicklaus won eighteen majors.

questions.q: Which player won the 1997 Masters by twelve shots?
questions.e: He was 21 and won by a record margin.

questions.q: Which golfer was nicknamed The Golden Bear?
questions.e: He earned the nickname early in his career.

questions.q: Which South African completed the career grand slam in 1965?
questions.e: He won all four majors at least once.

questions.q: Which American was known as The King?
questions.e: Palmer's following was called Arnie's Army.

questions.q: Which women's tour is the leading professional circuit?
questions.e: The Ladies Professional Golf Association, founded in 1950.

questions.q: What is a hole in one also called?
questions.e: It counts as a single stroke from the tee.

questions.q: What does the term par represent?
o: The expected number of strokes for a scratch golfer
questions.e: Par is set by hole length and difficulty.
